answer: Picture fake agents as boats crowding one jetty: they arrive in lockstep, phrase things alike, and moor at the same minutes. A network can cluster identities by that behavioral fingerprint (timing, wording, shared funding paths) and split one reward share across the whole cluster. A sybil farm then earns as a single agent no matter how many masks it wears, a canyon between its cost and its payout. Honest agents, who naturally differ in style, keep full shares; velvet gloves for them, a hard cap for the copies.
